claim_scores.rationale: Uses two `dspy.LM` instances with the same `api_base`, one `model_type="chat"` and one `model_type="text"`, then calls `forward` on both.
Asserts the chat capture contains `messages == [{"role": "user", "content": "ping"}]` when only `prompt="ping"` is passed.
Patches `litellm.completion` for chat, records the outbound request, and verifies that the captured chat call still carries the `messages` payload.
Patches `litellm.text_completion` for text and asserts the outbound prompt is exactly `ping\n\nBEGIN RESPONSE:`.
Asserts the text-side model is rewritten to `text-completion-openai/my-text-model` before LiteLLM text completion.
Captures explicit `api_base` forwarding on the text path and verifies the same fake endpoint is used; chat capture also includes the same `api_base` in the recorded request.
